prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: review-only modular character anatomy/style board for Caelum Argenteum, issue #736 under #458. This is concept artwork, not evidence of a native 3D model.
Primary request: one clean landscape comparison board showing exactly six full-body standing adult figures of BEAST MAN - WOLF. Top row: same adult male in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Bottom row: same adult female in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Orthographic-like views, identical scale within each row, full heads and soles visible, relaxed neutral stance with arms slightly away from the torso. Believable anatomy and joints, ordinary capable physiques, no exaggerated superhero or childlike proportions.
Style and presentation: closely match reference image 1's polished restrained 3D character concept rendering, plain light gray studio background, soft neutral light, fine cloth/leather textures and clear consistent view layout. Image 1 is only the proposed human board for shared clothing/material/lighting/layout; it must not erase the species anatomy in the other references.
Clothing: male and female wear the same practical plain ivory/cream long-sleeved lace-collar shirt, loose dark charcoal trousers, simple brown leather belt, separate brown leather gloves and calf boots as image 1. Fully covering, modest fit. Each garment must read as a separate removable layer; hair, if applicable, is not built into the shirt. No armor, cape, scarf, jewelry, weapons, shields, new accessories or environment. No numeric heights or gameplay claims.
Species requirements: Use the owned wolf head atlas in image 2 as the anatomy/color authority: real elongated wolf muzzle, pointed upright animal ears, gray-brown and cream fur, amber eyes. Both sexes must retain a complete animal head, no human face, human hairstyle or makeup. Adapt the collar to the furred neck. Male and female are naturally differentiated adult biped humanoid body silhouettes under identical plain clothes; female retains a fully lupine skull and muzzle, not a human face with ears. No tail is proposed in this board, and no change to limb, height or gameplay rules is implied. No claws projecting through closed gloves/boots.
Layout and exact text: title "BEAST MAN - WOLF / STYLE PROPOSAL"; subtitle "Concept only - pending author review"; row labels "MALE" and "FEMALE"; each row's column labels "FRONT", "PROFILE", "BACK". No other text. Generous spacing, crisp detail, no clipped body parts. Preserve each individual, clothing, color, head shape and hairstyle across its three views.
